targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: The Middleburg Page — the pilot. Jacquie Mars lives locally.
targets.Notes: Pilot site. Page also runs in The Georgetowner.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Second outlet for the pilot page — DC audience.
targets.Notes: Already carrying the page.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Mars, Incorporated global HQ since 1984. The single most valuable market in the list.
targets.Notes: Mars HQ is in this paper's coverage area. Highest symbolic value — 'Mars is closer than you think' printed in Mars' own hometown paper.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Same market — sister editions cover Vienna, Oakton, Great Falls.
targets.Notes: Same publisher as McLean Connection — one conversation covers several editions.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Alternative NoVa outlet covering Arlington and Fairfax County.
targets.Notes: Backup / additional NoVa reach.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Immediately adjacent to Middleburg — natural first expansion, same Hunt Country network.
targets.Notes: One of Virginia's oldest papers. Middleburg sits in Loudoun County.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Second Loudoun outlet — digital-first, strong local following.
targets.Notes: Independent and locally owned.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Western Loudoun weekly, small and independent.
targets.Notes: Very small — good proof that the model works at the smallest scale.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: North American Petcare headquarters. Pet-friendly campus with dog park and doggie daycare.
targets.Notes: STRATEGIC: Mars Petcare's own US HQ town. If any market should say yes, it's this one — and Ben Anders and Lindsay Kordik likely work here.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: $110M R&D campus incl. Pet Feeding Center housing up to 180 dogs and 120 cats. Global centre of excellence for Pedigree, Whiskas, Royal Canin, Iams.
targets.Notes: Same paper as Franklin. This site is also the best source of 'how Mars makes pet food' story material anywhere in the country.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Dry pet food, ~200,000 tons/yr. Opened 1984 as an Iams plant. Iams, Pedigree.
targets.Notes: BEST-FIT PROFILE: small town, independent weekly, major local employer. Closest analogue to the Middleburg situation.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Royal Canin. $185M expansion doubled the plant; +149 full-time jobs.
targets.Target Newspaper: Dakota Dunes/North Sioux City Times & Southern Union County Leader-Courier
targets.Notes: Small independent weekly, recent big Mars investment in town — strong local news hook.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Largest Royal Canin dry pet food factory in the world. $450M, opened 2025, 270 new jobs.
targets.Notes: Newest and biggest Mars pet food plant on earth, in a Preble County town of ~1,800. Enormous story-to-town ratio.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: 'DogStar Kitchen' — 371,000 sq ft on 85 acres. Orijen and Acana kibble, freeze-dried, treats.
targets.Notes: Logan County weekly. Champion joined Mars in Feb 2023.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Mars Petcare plant at 411 Martin Ave. Product mix not publicly disclosed.
targets.Notes: Lowest-profile Mars site found — almost no press coverage, which also means an untold story.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Largest dry food + treats producer in the North American network. Pedigree, Dentastix, Iams, Cesar. 40+ years in town.
targets.Notes: Covers Mattoon and Charleston, Coles County. Long Mars history in the community — 40th anniversary was covered by Mars itself.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Royal Canin. Came to Mars in the 2014 P&G / Iams transaction.
targets.Notes: Dodge County. Pairs naturally with Aurora NE — one state, two Mars plants, one press association.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: 109,000 sq ft at 3401 Eberhard Rd, operating since 1987. Pedigree, Iams, Cesar, Sheba, Whiskas, Nutro, Greenies, Eukanuba.
targets.Notes: Independent family-owned daily — decision-maker is reachable, no corporate ad-policy gatekeeping.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Royal Canin and Eukanuba, cat and dog. $200M expansion doubled capacity, +90 jobs.
targets.Notes: Third Tennessee Mars site — TN alone supports a state-level cluster pitch to the Tennessee Press Association.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Mars Wrigley chocolate — Dove bulk chocolate, M&M's, Snickers, Twix.
targets.Notes: Genuine small-town weekly in Lancaster County.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Skittles, Life Savers, Doublemint, Juicy Fruit. $50M / 145k sq ft Skittles line added 2016.
targets.Notes: Published continuously since 1864. Shaw Media owns several nearby weeklies — one yes could open a cluster.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Juicy Fruit, Extra, 5 Gum, Excel, Orbit.
targets.Notes: Hall County. Large Mars workforce relative to town size.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Sole global producer of COMBOS.
targets.Notes: Site downsized in 2023 when peanut roasting moved to Waco — check current sentiment before pitching.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: LARGEST MARS FOOD FACTORY IN THE WORLD. Ben's Original rice, Seeds of Change. 250k+ sq ft on 80 acres, 100k tonnes rice/yr, since 1978.
targets.Notes: Not a pet food site, but a flagship Mars community. Good candidate if the series ever widens past Petcare.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Exclusive global home of Peanut Butter M&M'S. Also Milk Chocolate & Peanut M&M'S, Twix. $142M expansion, 79 jobs.
targets.Notes: Bradley County.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Nature's Bakery bars — the brand's original home.
targets.Notes: State capital but small-market feel.

targets.Site Type: R&D lab — Antech North America hub
targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: $15.5M veterinary diagnostics R&D hub (former Heska site). In-house diagnostics, Allercept allergy business.
targets.Notes: Veterinary science angle — different story material from the food plants, good for variety in the series.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Nutro dry pet food, 30-acre site. NOTE: current operating status unconfirmed — verify before pitching.
targets.Notes: VERIFY THE PLANT IS STILL RUNNING before any outreach.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Headquarters of Banfield — 1,000+ veterinary clinics, mostly inside PetSmart. Mars-owned since 2007.
targets.Notes: Independent family-owned daily. Banfield gives a strong veterinary-expertise story angle.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Wet / tray-format pet food. Sheba, Cesar, Iams, Nutro, Pedigree, Whiskas, Acana, Orijen. One of the largest Mars Petcare US sites.
targets.Notes: Big workforce. Gannett ownership means ad decisions may sit outside the newsroom.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Snickers, Milky Way, 3 Musketeers. Opened 2014; $175M / 100+ job expansion 2022.
Snickers, Starburst, Skittles. Peanut roasting consolidated here from Albany GA in 2023. Since 1976.
targets.Notes: Pairs with Temple TX — two Mars sites ~35 miles apart, one Texas Press Association pitch.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Greenies, Greenies Pill Pockets, dog supplements, Royal Canin Pill Assist. $82M expansion, +95 jobs.
targets.Target Newspaper: TO VERIFY — seek KC community weekly
targets.Notes: Metro market — find a neighbourhood or suburban weekly rather than the Kansas City Star.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Royal Canin USA headquarters, 4 City Place Drive.
targets.Target Newspaper: TO VERIFY — seek St. Charles County weekly
targets.Notes: Royal Canin's US corporate home — worth a dedicated look for a suburban weekly.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Sole global maker of certain Life Savers and Altoids varieties. 35,000+ tonnes of mints a year. Since 1973.
targets.Notes: Metro daily — the community-paper pitch fits poorly. Consider a suburban weekly instead.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Ethel M Chocolates — sole global production site, with a public factory tour and cactus garden.
targets.Target Newspaper: Boulder City Review / Las Vegas Review-Journal
targets.Notes: The visitor centre is an unusually good story asset if a local weekly can be found.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Nature's Bakery — $240M, 339,000 sq ft, ~1 billion bars/yr. Opened July 2025.
targets.Notes: Metro market.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: Makes all Mars ice cream sold in the US — Snickers, Dove, Twix, M&M's, Milky Way, KIND frozen.
targets.Target Newspaper: TO VERIFY — seek DuPage County weekly
targets.Notes: Chicago suburb — several strong independent weeklies in the area, worth a look.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: M&M'S made on High St. since 1958. Also Snickers, Twix, Milky Way, Skittles, Starburst, Extra, Altoids. $70M+ investment from 2023.
targets.Notes: Print weekly coverage has thinned — TAPinto is digital-only, so the printed-page model needs adapting here. Huge Mars heritage though: M&M's have been made in this town for 68 years.

targets.What Mars Makes / Does There: BluePearl Specialty & Emergency Pet Hospital headquarters; network spans 29 states.
targets.Target Newspaper: TO VERIFY — seek Tampa-area community weekly
targets.Notes: Metro market, but emergency-vet stories are strong rescue-adjacent material.

targets.Target Newspaper: TO VERIFY — seek Chicago neighbourhood weekly
targets.Notes: Major Mars centre but a hard community-paper market. Note the corporate contacts likely sit here.

note: Community newspapers near Mars, Incorporated US sites. Qualifying filter: a community newspaper, a local animal shelter, and a local pet food store.
